item.text: {"search_note":"I found direct evidence for economic shock mitigation, protest dialogue, and conflict-displacement support. I found much less direct evidence for pandemic response, flood/disaster relief, famine operations, or systematic humanitarian relief coordination in 2024. The strongest negative evidence is outcome-based: food insecurity, inflation pain, and violent protest repression, which indicate suffering was still severe despite policy efforts.","evidence":[{"title":"Nigeria: IMF Executive Board concludes 2024 Article IV consultation / palliatives softened reform shock","publisher":"IMF","date":"2024-02-09","url":"https://www.imf.org/en/news/articles/2024/02/09/pr2443-nigeria-imf-exec-board-concludes-pfa","summary":"The IMF said Tinubu’s government paired subsidy removal and FX unification with cereals, subsidized fertilizer, a wage award, and diesel VAT suspension. This is strong evidence of active shock mitigation during an economic crisis.","question_ids":["6B.6","6B.5","6B.2"]},{"title":"President Tinubu directs expeditious processing of welfare benefits, demands monthly KPI reports","publisher":"State House","date":"2024-02-22","url":"https://statehouse.gov.ng/president-tinubu-directs-expeditious-processing-of-welfare-benefits-demands-monthly-kpi-reports/","summary":"Tinubu ordered faster welfare delivery and KPI reporting for vulnerable-citizen interventions. That is evidence of trying to reduce avoidable suffering through faster relief delivery.","question_ids":["6B.6","6B.5","6B.3"]},{"title":"President Tinubu calls for suspension of sanctions on Guinea, Mali, Niger, Burkina Faso","publisher":"State House","date":"2024-02-24","url":"https://statehouse.gov.ng/president-tinubu-calls-for-suspension-of-sanctions-on-guinea-mali-niger-burkina-faso/","summary":"Tinubu urged “a better path” through negotiation and improved governance rather than punitive escalation. This is indirect but real evidence of de-escalatory crisis management.","question_ids":["6B.6","6B.5"]},{"title":"President Tinubu establishes comprehensive economic coordination and planning system for Nigeria","publisher":"State House","date":"2024-03-27","url":"https://statehouse.gov.ng/president-tinubu-establishes-comprehensive-economic-coordination-and-planning-system-for-nigeria/","summary":"PECC/EET put technocrats at the center of emergency economic coordination. This supports a reading of crisis response through structured, expert-driven management rather than improvisation.","question_ids":["6B.6","6B.5","6B.4"]},{"title":"President Tinubu launches national resettlement scheme for conflict victims","publisher":"State House","date":"2024-07-06","url":"https://statehouse.gov.ng/president-tinubu-launches-national-resettlement-scheme-for-conflict-victims/","summary":"The scheme explicitly targeted displaced and conflict-affected communities and framed the effort as rehabilitation and reintegration. This is the clearest direct positive evidence for reducing suffering among crisis victims.","question_ids":["6B.6","6B.3","6B.2"]},{"title":"President Tinubu launches education campaign: no child should be excluded from learning","publisher":"State House","date":"2024-05-13","url":"https://statehouse.gov.ng/president-tinubu-launches-education-campaign-sys-no-child-should-be-excluded-from-learning/","summary":"Tinubu backed girls’ education, anti-GBV policy, and safe schooling for children. This is indirect crisis-relief evidence for vulnerable children and women, though it is more long-run protection than immediate crisis response.","question_ids":["6B.6","6B.3","6B.2"]},{"title":"President Tinubu approves takeoff of consumer credit scheme","publisher":"State House","date":"2024-04-24","url":"https://statehouse.gov.ng/president-tinubu-approves-takeoff-of-consumer-credit-scheme/","summary":"The scheme was framed as helping households finance homes, education, healthcare, and mobility. It is indirect evidence of cushioning economic shock and reducing hardship for ordinary households.","question_ids":["6B.6","6B.2","6B.3"]},{"title":"President Tinubu offers scholarships, housing to families of slain soldiers","publisher":"State House","date":"2024-03-27","url":"https://statehouse.gov.ng/president-tinubu-offers-scholarships-housing-to-families-of-slain-soldiers/","summary":"Tinubu ordered rapid material support for bereaved families, showing the state used direct benefits to reduce suffering after violent loss.","question_ids":["6B.6","6B.3"]},{"title":"President Tinubu acknowledges nationwide protest, hardship, deaths, and destruction","publisher":"State House","date":"2024-08-04","url":"https://statehouse.gov.ng/president-tinubus-broadcast-on-the-nationwide-protest/","summary":"Tinubu publicly acknowledged public frustration, deaths, and destruction tied to economic hardship. This is evidence of recognizing the crisis and trying to manage it politically rather than denying it.","question_ids":["6B.6","6B.5"]},{"title":"Tinubu asks protesters to suspend demonstrations, seeks dialogue","publisher":"TheCable","date":"2024-08-04","url":"https://www.thecable.ng/breaking-tinubu-asks-protesters-to-suspend-demonstrations-seeks-dialogue/","summary":"Tinubu explicitly asked protesters to pause demonstrations so dialogue could happen. This is a genuine restraint signal, though reactive and limited.","question_ids":["6B.6","6B.5"]},{"title":"Nigeria police used excessive force to violently quash #EndBadGovernance protests","publisher":"Amnesty International","date":"2024-11-28","url":"https://www.amnesty.org/en/latest/news/2024/11/nigeria-police-used-excessive-force-to-violently-quash-endbadgovernance-protests/","summary":"Amnesty documented killings, mass detentions, and torture during protests over economic hardship. This is the strongest negative evidence that 2024 did not ultimately reduce avoidable suffering during a major domestic crisis.","question_ids":["6B.6","6B.3","6B.5"]},{"title":"Hundreds gather across Nigerian cities to protest cost of living crisis","publisher":"Reuters via Investing.com","date":"2024-08-01","url":"https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/hundreds-gather-across-nigerian-cities-to-protest-cost-of-living-crisis-3548376","summary":"Reuters tied protests to subsidy removal, naira devaluation, electricity tariff hikes, and inflation above 34 percent. This shows the shock response had not yet reduced suffering for many households.","question_ids":["6B.6","6B.2","6B.5"]},{"title":"Insecurity, rising costs push 31 million Nigerians into acute food shortage, study says","publisher":"Reuters via Investing.com","date":"2024-08-27","url":"https://www.investing.com/news/economy-news/insecurity-rising-costs-push-31-million-nigerians-into-acute-food-shortage-study-says-3589474","summary":"The report said 31.8 million Nigerians were acutely food insecure. That is the clearest negative evidence that avoidable suffering remained severe in 2024.","question_ids":["6B.6","6B.2","6B.3"]},{"title":"Nigeria has detained journalist who reported on corruption in widening crackdown","publisher":"Reuters via GPB","date":"2024-05-09","url":"https://www.gpb.org/news/2024/05/09/nigeria-has-detained-journalist-who-reported-on-corruption-in-widening-crackdown","summary":"Detaining a journalist over corruption reporting weakens the feedback loop needed to detect suffering and correct policy failures.","question_ids":["6B.6","6B.5"]},{"title":"Nigeria police charge 4 journalists with cybercrimes for corruption reporting","publisher":"CPJ","date":"2024-10-03","url":"https://cpj.org/2024/10/nigeria-police-charge-4-journalists-with-cybercrimes-for-corruption-reporting/","summary":"Continued legal pressure on journalists suggests a punitive information environment, which makes it harder to see and fix avoidable suffering.","question_ids":["6B.6","6B.5"]},{"title":"Freedom House, Nigeria: Freedom on the Net 2024","publisher":"Freedom House","date":"2024","url":"https://freedomhouse.org/country/nigeria/freedom-net/2024","summary":"Freedom House describes legal pressure, monitoring, blocking powers, and harassment of journalists. That is negative evidence for transparent crisis correction.","question_ids":["6B.6","6B.5"]},{"title":"FG spent N63.6bn on military equipment in seven months, report says","publisher":"Punch","date":"2024-08-17","url":"https://punchng.com/fg-spent-n63-6bn-on-military-equipment-in-seven-months-report/","summary":"Weakly disclosed security spending raises diversion and opportunity-cost concerns during a period of household distress. It does not prove abuse, but it weakens the case that resources were being used to reduce suffering efficiently.","question_ids":["6B.6","6B.5"]}]}
